exact_prompt:
Edit this exact complete game diffuse UV map into a modest HD hand-painted texture. The reference is the entire native128x64 stored RGB canvas enlarged NEAREST4x512x256, not an object illustration. Return the entire2:1canvas with exactly the same normalized UV positions, outline, scale, original gaps, material fields and tiny original paintmarks. No crop, padding, frame, fitting, zoom, recentering, extra whitespace or arrangement change.

Preserve the muted gray-green soft matte painted cloth. Keep the original upper curved field and small upper-left green patch, EXACTLY TWO long lower-left horizontal green fields with their existing angular black separator, and EXACTLY ONE separate right oval green field. Preserve the source partial fades/irregular paleleft patches, broad soft creases and weak original lightedges in exactly their positions. Those tiny pale patches must remain diffuse paint, not new buttons, rivets, stitches or holes. Keep the oval field almost flat with the original faint broad tonal variation, not a raised thick rim.

Only gently resolve the existing soft mottled paint at its original pattern scale. Avoid adding a new weave or threadgrain. Near-flat regions stay near-flat. Retain source soft margins, subdued palette, dim dark curves and each original local lightpatch's relative strength. No new part, seam, pocket, stripe, crease, border, buckle, crack, scratch, speck, raised bevel, padded edge, shiny leather, white rim, engraving, badge, text, symbol or decorative curl. Output an opaque entire UV canvas; original source alpha is restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST4x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
